items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change adds one call with a clear comment ('# Ensure base table is in aliases.') and matches the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias() helper in single_alias. There is no duplication, no dead code, and Collector/QuerySet.delete are left alone.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The one-line fix adds no new error paths or magic constants. get_initial_alias() is idempotent and safe on queries that are already joined. Hidden tests pass: F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias, where the base alias is registered before aliases are counted. Joined deletes still count more than one alias and keep the subquery. The MySQL override that uses single_alias benefits from the same fix. There is no backend-specific branch.
